title: Retain a rank-three same-class obstruction to every fixed fugacity tilt
statement: For the exact single-linkage rank-three network in the accepted audit, the fast conservative birth/death imbalance is -(r-1)(r-2)(r-3). Every fixed alpha in (0,1) and fixed fugacity has some positive tilted H. The phase 0,1,4 principal block has gain 24A(A)_3 and positive limiting eigenvalue H/(r^3-H) after choosing 0<H<r^3; every finite cutoff K>=4 fails Hurwitz there. The escaping states lie in ONE actual communicating class. Physical phase exits coexist with a CLOSED lifted component, so the leaky theorem is inapplicable. This defeats that frozen representation, not recurrence or every nonfrozen construction.
